why: Both read Remark 4.14 in a chart but in different chart situations: A uses an arbitrary chart φ around a, the shrunken set W = V ∩ dom φ ∩ s⁻¹(V ∩ dom φ), T_aX = T_zO for the whole model O and Ts(a) = the tangent map of ρ = φ∘s∘φ⁻¹ between the retracts φ(W) (retractTangentMap), concluding z smooth, Tρ(z)(T_zO) = T_aA, T_aA ⊆ T_aX, dim T_aA < ∞; B uses the reduced situation V ⊆ dom φ, r(U) = φ(V) and Ts(a) = Dt(z) for t = φ∘s∘φ⁻¹∘r, and adds s(V) ⊆ X_∞, T_aA = range Dt(z) and 'Dt(z) is an sc⁺-operator'. A ⇒ B: A applied to the restricted chart φ|_V (W = V, model φ(V)) gives (a) via retractTangentMap_eqOn (= D(ρ∘r)(z) on T_z(φ(V))) and finite-dimensionality; s(V) ⊆ X_∞ from A's 'z smooth' and mem_smoothSet_iff; B's two extra claims (range, sc⁺-operator) are NOT in A's statement and were obtained from the non-banned project lemma exists_chartRetraction (the sc⁺-retraction t of V4_30) with scDeriv_eq_of_eqOn_relOpen, tangentSpace_eq_range and IsScPlus.exists_scPlus_deriv — so A omits the text's 'image of the sc⁺-operator Ts(a)' but a sibling lemma supplies it. B ⇒ A: B applied to V := W and r := R|_{R⁻¹(G)} (φ(W) = O ∩ G) gives the tangent-map identity (tangentSpace_inter_isOpen: T_z(O ∩ G) = T_zO) and finite-dimensionality, smoothness of z from s(V) ⊆ X_∞; A's T_aA ⊆ T_aX is a general fact on sub-retracts (tangentSpace_subset_of_subset), proved without B.
overlap: 310 shared project theorems, nearly all statement vocabulary (M-polyfold charts, SubData.shrink API, retract tangent spaces, sc-calculus); proof-level lemmas also used by the project's proof of remark_4_14: tangentSpace_inter_isOpen, tangentSpace_subset_of_subset (A's third conjunct, re-derived outright), SubData.rho_isScSmooth, retractTangentMap_eqOn (via proposition_2_21_4 in the project), tangentSpace_eq_range. The project's key steps for the conclusion (proposition_2_21_4, exists_chartRetraction, lemma_4_7_i/ii) are not reused by B_to_A.
